defect.cause: The world ProximityPrompt ActionText says Make <toy>, but the Triggered callback only changes the selected auto-production toy and never buys or spawns a toy immediately.
defect.reproduction: Execute the canonical server through tests/roblox_server_harness.lua, inspect the selector ActionText and trigger the GUARDON pad; the pinned old server displays Make GUARDON while coins and Allies remain unchanged.
defect.scope: Whole-server native Lua mock only; Roblox physical prompt/UI and multiplayer not tested.

fix: Change the three selector prompt action labels from Make <toy> to Select <toy> without changing selection, production, costs, or combat.
character_impact: Only the text of all three selection pads changes. PON, GUARDON and TANKURU stats, prices, selected values and purchase behavior are unchanged.

tests.negative_control: Pinned old canonical server in CI
